# The wait-helper port keeps DOM-valued waits and pre-action promises

The comm wait-helper port changes the receiver while retaining caller use of the result and action order. getAddonElement returns the wait promise, and its caller uses the awaited addon-card. isExtensionLocked queries the awaited addon-card directly. The spaces-toolbar test saves its style wait before changing fullScreen and awaits that promise after the action. These are checked caller requirements. The upstream helper implementation was not paired, so the source does not establish promise-result, timeout or polling equivalence.

Scope: Thunderbird browser-test wait-helper callers.
